cards.card_text: So now he writes to the ones he calls “holy brothers, who share in the heavenly calling,” and his ask is simple: “set your focus on Jesus, the apostle and high priest whom we confess.”
cards.verse_text: Therefore, holy brothers, who share in the heavenly calling, set your focus on Jesus, the apostle and high priest whom we confess.
cards.snippet: …who share in the heavenly calling, set your focus on Jesus, the apostle and high priest whom we confess.

cards.card_text: This is a letter from Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the elect who are exiles scattered across Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia and Bithynia.
cards.verse_text: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, To the elect who are exiles of the Dispersion throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia, chosen
cards.snippet: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, To the elect who are exiles of the Dispersion…

cards.card_text: Grab a seat, friend, because Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, is writing a letter.
cards.verse_text: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who through the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ have received a faith as precious as ours:
cards.snippet: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who through the righteousness of our God…

cards.card_text: Then Jude turns back to his readers, the beloved, and tells them to remember what the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ foretold.
cards.verse_text: But you, beloved, remember what was foretold by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ
cards.snippet: But you, beloved, remember what was foretold by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ

cards.card_text: Some people claimed to be apostles.
cards.verse_text: I know that you cannot tolerate those who are evil, and you have tested and exposed as liars those who falsely claim to be apostles.
cards.snippet: …have tested and exposed as liars those who falsely claim to be apostles.

cards.card_text: Now a call goes out to heaven, friend, and to the saints and apostles and prophets.
cards.verse_text: Rejoice over her, O heaven, and you saints and apostles and prophets, because God has pronounced for you His judgment against her.
cards.snippet: Rejoice over her, O heaven, and you saints and apostles and prophets, because God has pronounced for you His judgment against her.

cards.card_text: What are heaven and the saints and apostles and prophets told to do over her?
cards.verse_text: Rejoice over her, O heaven, and you saints and apostles and prophets, because God has pronounced for you His judgment against her.
cards.snippet: Rejoice over her, O heaven, and you saints and apostles and prophets, because God has pronounced for you His judgment against her.

cards.verse_text: The wall of the city had twelve foundations bearing the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
cards.snippet: …of the city had twelve foundations bearing the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
